name: stirling-pdf
description: Private browser-based PDF tools for converting, editing, signing, OCR, and organizing documents

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_PORT
fields.label: R1: App Port
fields.help: Host port used to open Stirling-PDF in your browser.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_TESSDATA_LOCATION
fields.label: R2: OCR Language Data Folder
fields.help: Stores Tesseract OCR language data used by Stirling-PDF.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_CONFIG_LOCATION
fields.label: R3: Config Folder
fields.help: Stores Stirling-PDF configuration files.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_LOGS_LOCATION
fields.label: O1: Logs Folder
fields.help: Stores application logs.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_CUSTOM_FILES_LOCATION
fields.label: O2: Custom Files Folder
fields.help: Stores custom files such as logos, templates, and UI customizations.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_PIPELINE_LOCATION
fields.label: O3: Pipeline Folder
fields.help: Stores pipeline configuration and reusable processing workflows.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_MODE
fields.label: O4: Mode
fields.help: Controls whether Stirling-PDF exposes the web UI, API, or both.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_ENABLE_SECURITY
fields.label: O5: Enable Security
fields.help: Enables Stirling-PDF security features. Leave enabled unless you intentionally run it only on a trusted private network.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_ENABLE_LOGIN
fields.label: R4: Enable Login
fields.help: Controls whether Stirling-PDF requires users to log in. When enabled, Stirling-PDF uses its default initial credentials on first startup.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_DEFAULT_LOCALE
fields.label: O6: Default Locale
fields.help:
Default locale for the web interface.
Example: en-US.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_APP_NAME
fields.label: O7: App Name
fields.help: Name shown in the Stirling-PDF web interface.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_HOME_DESCRIPTION
fields.label: O8: Home Description
fields.default: Private PDF tools running on your UGREEN NAS
fields.help: Short description shown on the Stirling-PDF home page.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_MAX_FILE_SIZE
fields.label: O9: Maximum File Size
fields.help: Maximum upload size used by Stirling-PDF. The value is usually entered in MB.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_METRICS_ENABLED
fields.label: O10: Enable Metrics
fields.help: Controls whether Stirling-PDF metrics are enabled.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: O11: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_IMAGE
fields.label: A1: Image
fields.help:
Docker image used for Stirling-PDF.
Change this only if you want a different tag or image source.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_DISABLE_ADDITIONAL_FEATURES
fields.label: Disable Additional Features
fields.help: Recipe-managed setting required for Docker login and additional security features.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: EasyDocker sets the container name from the project name.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_INTERNAL_PORT
fields.label: Internal App Port
fields.help: Recipe-managed Stirling-PDF internal port.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_TESSDATA_TARGET
fields.label: OCR Data Path Inside Container
fields.help: Recipe-managed internal path for Tesseract OCR language data.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_CONFIG_TARGET
fields.label: Config Path Inside Container
fields.help: Recipe-managed internal config path.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_LOGS_TARGET
fields.label: Logs Path Inside Container
fields.help: Recipe-managed internal logs path.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_CUSTOM_FILES_TARGET
fields.label: Custom Files Path Inside Container
fields.help: Recipe-managed internal custom files path.

fields.name: STIRLING_PDF_PIPELINE_TARGET
fields.label: Pipeline Path Inside Container
fields.help: Recipe-managed internal pipeline path.

ui.overview: Stirling-PDF is a private web app for common PDF tasks such as merging, splitting, converting, compressing, signing, redacting, and OCR.
what_happens: A Stirling-PDF container will be created
The web interface will be published on the port you choose
OCR data, config, logs, custom files, and pipeline folders will be stored under the app project folder by default
Login security is enabled by default and Stirling-PDF will use its default initial credentials on first startup
ui.data_location: Relative paths are stored inside this app's project folder under the mounted EasyDocker base config path.
